video_title: Media Availability: Head Coach Brian Keefe | 11.11.26

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Keefe on fourth quarter stagnation and defensive lapses
quotes.excerpt: the difference in the game was we got stagnant there to start the fourth quarter
quotes.quote: The difference in the game was we got stagnant there to start the fourth quarter. The ball movement that we had in the second quarter wasn't there. They obviously went on a run. Our defense was not tied together as much as I would have liked in the fourth. The lack of ball movement, some of the turnovers to start the run, and then we were scrambling to get back in the game the rest of the game. 37 points in the fourth was way too much, and that was the difference.
quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe says the difference in tonight's loss was fourth quarter stagnation. He noted that the ball movement from the second quarter disappeared and the defense was not tied together as they allowed 37 points in the final frame.

structured.context: Head coach Brian Keefe explains the reasons behind the team's fourth-quarter collapse against the Indiana Pacers.

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Keefe on the second unit's performance and Indiana's physicality
quotes.excerpt: That unit was terrific in the first half, that was the group that really got us the lead
quotes.quote: That unit was terrific in the first half, that was the group that really got us the lead. You saw how they were playing, the ball movement was flying around, it started with our defense, that group was really active. You got to give a little credit to Indiana too, they upped their physicality and we didn't handle it well. We will take a look, we will learn from that, and we will get ready to go tomorrow.
quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe praised the second unit for their first half performance but admitted the team struggled to handle Indiana's increased physicality as the game went on.

structured.context: Brian Keefe discusses the second unit's performance and how the Indiana Pacers increased their physicality in the second half.

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Keefe credits Trey Johnson's defensive activity and energy
quotes.excerpt: I think it was his defense. He was so active. You saw his getting disruptions
quotes.quote: I think it was his defense. He was so active. You saw his getting disruptions, he was in the paint. I think he was really focused on that and then the ball just found him. The ball had energy, like I said he was in with that group, he found him, he made some good shots, but I think it really started with his defense. I think that's what really turned it for him. Really good effort from him tonight.
quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe credited Trey Johnson for his impact tonight, saying his offensive success was a direct result of his defensive activity. Keefe noted that Johnson was getting disruptions and staying active in the paint.

structured.context: Brian Keefe praises Trey Johnson for his defensive energy and activity during the game.
